d: Short, jet black hair with textured layers and bangs sweeping across the forehead. Sharp, narrowed eyes of a deep crimson shade. An adolescent appearance with a slender, lean build. Dressed in a formal black three-piece suit consisting of a blazer, vest, and trousers, paired with a white collared shirt, a dark blue necktie, black dress shoes, and black fingerless tactical gloves. Signature details include two long, braided golden-yellow cords hanging from the right shoulder and a large, futuristic black tactical rifle with a glowing blue circular accent.
